thread:
Sam (PM): Quick sync — we have 3 enterprise customers asking for a migration path when we onboard model variants that change tokenization or response shape. proposing: 30d migration runway + opt-in pinning + automated compatibility checks. ok?
Julie (Eng): +1 to runway but need to scope what "compatibility checks" mean. tokenization changes are messy. we should block on e2e smoke + sample prompts.
Raj (Infra): can do infra for staged rollouts. suggest canary + regional fallbacks. deploy-bot will run canary health checks.
Ana (ML): For benchmarks, recommend: (1) median latency delta, (2) top-1 generation quality on eval set, (3) hallucination rate on critical prompts. set guardrails: latency increase >15% OR quality drop >2% triggers hold.
Mark (SE): Customers want explicit pin API. they need a quick way to pin to older model_id for X customers. Expose `pin_version(customer_id, model_id)` and `pin_expiry`.
Tess (Support): we've got 4 open tickets asking for migration freeze windows during billing cycles. also enterprise legal wants a 60‑day notice in contracts.
Sam (PM): ok tradeoffs: PM proposal -> 30d default runway, 60d for enterprise customers who opt in (contract flag), pin API, and automated checks that block rollouts. decision points: guardrail thresholds (Ana), rollout policy (Raj), UX/API (Mark).
Julie (Eng): Implementation note: for tokenization diffs we'll add a compatibility shim that maps old tok ids where possible. but full backward compat isn't always possible. fallback will be "hard-pin" to previous model.
Ana (ML): we'll provide a small eval harness: `catalog/compat_check --model=new --baseline=old --prompts=sample_set.json` output includes `quality_score`, `latency_ms`, `regressions` list. sample thresholds: `quality_score_drop_pct <= 1.5`, `p95_latency_delta <= 12%`.
Raj (Infra): rollout config snippet (draft):
```yaml
rollout_policy:
  canary_percent: 5
  canary_duration: 24h
  ramp_steps: [5,20,50]
  health_checks: [latency, errors, quality_regressions]
  rollback_conditions:
    latency_increase_pct: 15
    quality_drop_pct: 2
```
Mark (SE): API example for pin: `POST /v1/customers/:id/pins` body `{ "model_id": "redwood-llama-3", "expires_at": "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z" }` will return `pin_id`. need docs + SDK helpers.
Tess (Support): propose we add a playbook: how to respond if a customer complains during migration — include steps to pin, escalate to eng, and open rollback.
Sam (PM): next steps: Ana finalizes thresholds by EOD Thu, Raj wires rollout with deploy-bot by Mon, Julie drafts shim MVP + dev tasks, Mark drafts API spec, Tess writes support playbook. sync Fri 11am?
Julie (Eng): FYI: unknowns -> models with changed function-calling signature. may require contraction of tooling to auto-map old args. flagging as medium risk.
Ana (ML): will include function-call compatibility in eval suite. if incompatible, flag as "breaking" and block automated rollout.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job created: `canary/1787654321` will run nightly for the next 3 days and post results to #eng-runtime.
Sam (PM): thanks — I'll update the roadmap ticket and add launch criteria to the PR template: must pass compat checks + have pin API + support playbook. :white_check_mark:
Mark (SE): noted — I'll add SDK helpers and sample curl snippets to the spec.
Tess (Support): adding a template email for customers to explain migration timeline. will share in the doc. :email:
Sam (PM): cool — closing this thread. if anything blocks, ping me directly.
